s.note: Soft baked buns filled with buttery cabbage, onion, egg and dill.
s.how: Mix 500g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tbsp caster sugar and 1 tsp salt with 250ml warm milk, 60g melted butter and 1 egg, and knead for 10 minutes until smooth. Cover and prove for an hour until doubled. Meanwhile boil 2 eggs for 9 minutes, and cook 500g finely shredded white cabbage and 1 diced onion slowly in 40g butter for 25 minutes until soft and sweet. Season with 0.5 tsp salt and 0.5 tsp pepper, cool, then mix in the chopped eggs and 2 tbsp chopped dill. Divide the dough into 16, flatten each, fill, pinch closed and set seam side down on lined trays. Rest 15 minutes, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until golden.

s.n: Train carriage herring on black bread
s.note: Pickled herring on buttered rye with red onion and dill, a cold bite for the siding.
s.how: Butter 8 slices of dark rye bread and cut each in half. Lay a piece of pickled herring on each with thin red onion rings and dill. Grind over black pepper and serve cold.

m.n: Kremlin chicken Kiev with buttered peas
m.note: Crumbed chicken breast round a core of garlic butter, with buttered peas, cut at the table.
m.how: Mash 100g soft butter with 2 crushed garlic cloves and chopped parsley, roll into a log and freeze 20 minutes. Butterfly 4 chicken breasts, pound thin, wrap each round a quarter of the butter and chill. Dip in flour, beaten egg and breadcrumbs twice, fry until golden then bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Serve with buttered peas.

w.n: Siding syrniki with sour cream and jam
w.note: Golden cottage cheese pancakes with sour cream and cherry jam, still warm from the pan.
w.how: Mix 500g cottage cheese with 2 eggs, 3 tbsp sugar, a pinch of salt and 100g plain flour. Shape into 12 small thick rounds in more flour. Fry in butter over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Serve warm with sour cream and cherry jam.

d.n: Samovar tea with lemon and jam
d.note: Strong black tea poured hot over lemon, a spoon of jam on the side to stir in.
d.how: Brew 4 tsp strong black tea leaves in 1 litre of boiling water for 4 minutes and strain. Pour into glasses with a slice of lemon in each, and serve with sugar cubes and a little dish of cherry jam to stir in.
